Bug_Title: Unnecessary equality checks should not be made
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by comparing unrelated classes, comparing an unrelated class and interface, comparing unrelated interface types, comparing an array to a non-array, comparing two arrays and comparing an object with null.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when an equality check (==) is made between an instance of Spatula and an instance of Tree. This results in a false return value which is the expected behavior as these are unrelated classes. Therefore, the assertion in the JUnit test should be 'assertTrue(buggyCode.showBug())' to validate that the bug is triggered.
